metadata.ut_note: All Julian Days are UT; inputs treated as UTC (UT ~= UTC here).
metadata.notes: Random UTC instants in [1950-01-01, 2100-12-31]. tropical = apparent geocentric ecliptic longitude (true equinox of date, swe.calc_ut default). sidereal = SEFLG_SIDEREAL with SIDM_LAHIRI. ayanamsha_mean = swe.get_ayanamsa_ut(); ayanamsha_true = swe.get_ayanamsa_ex_ut() (the value SEFLG_SIDEREAL applies).
